vuln_type: Business logic - empty-market exchange-rate and redemption accounting flaw
adjudication_basis: Both accounts explain lowering hWBTC supply to two wei, sending WBTC directly to inflate its exchange rate, borrowing ETH against the distorted valuation and withdrawing WBTC while consuming only one hWBTC. BlockSec explicitly explains rounding down and under-burning; SolidityScan corroborates the exchange-rate and redemption sequence independently. The adjudicated class captures their common accounting mechanism rather than copying a title. This April2023 Optimism incident is distinct from March2022 Hundred Finance Gnosis reentrancy.
